result.summary: Fix 1 (AC10): added a new subsection in §2 ('AC10's separate, migration-file-level requirement') instructing that the migration file creating repository_artifacts/artifact_versions must carry a top-of-file comment stating the per-tenant placement decision and its condensed reasoning (Decision B blast-radius rationale, no AC requiring cross-tenant dedup), explicitly distinguished from AC11's moduledoc-based 058-vs-045 conflict recording. §10's AC10 row now points at this migration-comment instruction rather than at §1 alone. Fix 2 (OQ-2): §3.2 now states as settled, non-deferred fact that promotion_digest.ex's moduledoc will be edited to add the reciprocal cross-reference -- required by AC5 clause (iii) 'BOTH moduledocs cross-reference each other', since promotion_digest.ex currently has zero Canonicaliser references and no edit-free way exists to make both moduledocs cross-reference each other. Explains why the previously-proposed fallback (cross-reference only on the Canonicaliser side) fails AC5 outright (violates 'BOTH'). AC5 clause (ii) 'is NOT modified' is now explicitly read as 'no behavioral change' (canonicalize/1, compute_plan_digest/1, verify_digest/2 unchanged), making the moduledoc-only git diff --stat hit on promotion_digest.ex intentional and required, and instructs that the commit/PR description must say so explicitly. OQ-2 removed from §9's open-questions list (replaced with a pointer to the §3.2 resolution); §10's AC5 row updated to reflect the resolved reading instead of citing OQ-2. OQ-1/OQ-3/OQ-4 left exactly as-is per the validator's own confirmation that they are legitimate ELIXIR-DEV deferrals with no AC depending on their resolution. No implementation code was added or existed already (grep for markdown code fences returns nothing).
